authorization_context: Owner explicitly requested another real API trial using the existing Alibaba Bailian model; spend within existing authorization.

cost_accounting.policy: Uncached list-price upper bound; failed/unverifiable calls retain full reservation. Stop before another request if reservation cannot fit the remaining batch budget.

decoding_note: Requested temperature=0, top_p=1, seed=null. No cross-provider deterministic or equal-reasoning-effort guarantee.

evaluation.mechanical: Retain every initial, repaired and failed response; distinguish compilation from semantic correctness.
evaluation.reference: Author audit against these predeclared source boundaries, not independent human gold or model-review approval.
semantic: Operation predicate excludes concrete participants/conditions/order while preserving action/API distinctions.
Actual participant roles must be source-supported; ambiguous username insertion may remain unresolved, not become confirmed absence.
Password hashing-before-insertion and named privilege ordering must remain requirement-owned; operation presence alone is not independent context.
Generation output contract, task-wide behavior and exception condition remain represented; supported unrelated requirements survive repair.
evaluation.unit: One natural task; extraction/review/patch calls are not independent task samples.

limits: No protected/new tasks, Discovery, code outcomes, paper or Pair changes.
Same case input, instruction, catalog, schema, implementation, output/time/response caps and evaluation criteria as the completed DeepSeek thinking batch.
One draw per task; no extra reviewer, resampling, fallback model or parameter tuning.
Descriptive provider/model configuration comparison; provider default reasoning and decoding semantics are not identical.
Missing final content or non-stop finish is retained as delivery failure; reasoning text is never parsed into a replacement graph.
The 12-yuan batch ceiling can stop the run before all ten allowed calls if reservations cannot fit.
purpose: Compare the same two exposed tasks and unchanged TSG extraction/review/local-patch pipeline using the existing Qwen Max snapshot on Alibaba Bailian, with thinking enabled and final-content-only parsing.
source_interpretation_notes: Retain the pre-existing username insertion ambiguity separately from confirmed defects.
Do not certify pass-as-required-empty-implementation as a coverage gain; distinguish scaffold interpretation from confirmed omissions.
stop_rule: Complete the two planned cases with only the existing mechanical correction/review/local-patch limits; no rerun, fallback model, retuning or extra reviewer after outcomes.
thinking_effort: enable_thinking=true; no explicit thinking_budget. Provider default reasoning limit applies inside the 65536 total output budget.
